VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the agent claims all 72 tests pass and describes a plausible fix (switching to integer cents), there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate these claims. The acceptance criteria explicitly require that "all 72 tests pass," which demands verifiable proof, not assertion. A self-report is the weakest admissibility class and cannot establish objective test results without supporting documentation.
